_comment: Canonical share-service constants shared by the Rust axum server (core/codegen.rs + src/server.rs) and the TypeScript Cloudflare Worker (worker/src/index.ts). Both test suites assert against this file (core: tests/constants_parity.rs, worker: src/constants-parity.test.ts) so drift on either side fails that side's CI. kvMinTtlSeconds is a Cloudflare KV platform constraint and is asserted only by the Worker. The blob* / maxBlob* / readTicketTtlSeconds keys are the ADR-0222 file-blob limits (core/src/blobs.rs on the Rust side).
